qa.question: When did Caroline go to the LGBTQ support group?
What did Caroline and Melanie both do last spring?
qa.answer: They both ran a charity race

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you!

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Hey Caroline! How have you been?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: That is wonderful. I ran a charity race last month too.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: I have been looking into adoption agencies lately.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: Did you also run that charity race? I remember you trained hard.
